evidence.label: CometBFT consensus overview
evidence.claim: CometBFT implements a Byzantine-fault-tolerant consensus protocol with cryptographic validator signing and a light-client verification protocol.

evidence.label: CometBFT validators
evidence.claim: Validators commit blocks using cryptographically signed votes; proof of stake is not required by CometBFT and can be layered on by the application. Current validator consensus keys use Ed25519.
